rules: 主语是单数，动词要加 s；主语是复数，动词用原形。
child 的复数是 children，不是 childrens。
water、milk、bread 这类不可数名词没有复数形式。
news 虽然以 s 结尾，但它是不可数名词，当单数用。
说一整类东西时，名词用复数，动词也配复数。
句首主语用主格（I / he / she / we / they），动词后面用宾格（me / him / her / us / them）。
物主代词（my / his / her / our / their）后面必须跟名词。
名词性的物主代词（mine / his / hers）自己就代替了名词，后面不能再跟名词。
主语是第三人称单数，动词要加 s。
I / you / we / they 后面用动词原形。
be 动词：I 用 am，he / she / it 用 is，you / we / they 用 are。
辅音字母 + y 结尾的动词，加 s 时把 y 变 i 再加 es。
形容词放在名词前面，而且没有复数形式。
be 动词后面用形容词，不能用副词。
形容词不能用 -ly 结尾 —— 那是副词的样子。
修饰动词要用副词，不能用形容词。
well 是副词，good 是形容词。
hard 是「努力」，hardly 是「几乎不」，两个词意思不一样。
有些副词不带 -ly：fast、hard、late。
元音音素开头用 an，辅音音素开头用 a。
第一次提到用 a / an，再提到同一个东西用 the。
独一无二或特指的东西用 the。
a / an 看的是紧跟它后面那个词的发音 —— 后面跟形容词时，就看形容词。
on 是表面接触，in 是「在里面」。
to 表示方向，from 表示来源。
具体时间点用 at，月份年份用 in，具体某一天用 on。
介词后面跟名词，一起组成介词短语，说明「在哪、去哪、什么时候」。
and 是并列（都算），or 是选择（二选一）。
but 表示转折，前后意思相反。
so 引出结果，because 引出原因 —— 一个句子里只能留一个。
一个主语加一个动词，就是最小的一句话。
主语是单数，动词要加 s；主语是复数，动词用原形。
不及物动词（arrive / rise / happen / sleep）后面不需要宾语，句子到这里就完整了。
动词后面要有东西接住它，句子意思才完整 —— 这就是宾语。
主语是第三人称单数，动词加 s。
泛指一类东西时，宾语用复数；不可数名词永远不加 s。
be 动词跟着主语走：I 用 am，he / she / it 用 is，you / we / they 用 are。
be 动词后面是表语，不是宾语 —— 它说明主语「是什么、怎么样」。
主语是单数，表语也跟着单数。
表语要用形容词，不能用副词。
双宾语的顺序是「先人后物」：先给谁，再给什么。
间接宾语（人）要用宾格：me / him / her / us / them。
主语是第三人称单数，动词加 s。
宾语后面再补一句说明它，就是宾语补足语。
宾补说明的是宾语的状态，要用形容词，不是副词。
boring 形容东西（让人无聊），bored 形容人的感受（感到无聊）。
call / name 这类动词后面，宾补是名词。
there be 句型里，be 动词跟着后面那个「真正的主语」变，不看 there。
every 后面永远跟单数名词，动词也用单数。
glasses / pants / scissors 这些词天生是复数，动词用 are。
news 虽然以 s 结尾，但它是不可数名词，当单数用。
一般现在时的疑问句要在句首加 Do 或 Does，后面的动词用原形。
Does 出现后，动词一定要还原成原形 —— 三单的活已经交给 Does 了。
be 动词的疑问句把 is / are / am 直接提到句首，不用 do。
主谓宾：动词后面要有东西接住它。
主系表：be 动词后面是表语，说明主语是什么、怎么样。
双宾语：先人后物，人用宾格。
宾语补足语说明宾语的状态，要用形容词。
一般现在时的疑问句用 Do / Does，后面动词还原成原形。
there be 跟着后面那个真正的主语变，不看 there。
however 表示转折：前后两句意思相反。它后面要加逗号，另起一句。
however 是副词，不是连词 —— 不能像 but 那样把两句连在一个句子里。
moreover / in addition 表示递进，补充同方向的信息，不是结果。
on the other hand 用来看同一件事的两面：一面好，一面坏。
先判断两句是什么关系（转折 / 递进 / 因果），再挑衔接词。
先说原因，再说结果；结果那句用 as a result 起头，后面加逗号。
therefore / consequently 也是「因此」，比口语的 so 正式，一样要另起一句。
because of 后面只能跟名词或代词（because of this）；because 后面才跟句子。
两句方向一致、顺理成章才是因果；方向相反要用 however。
因果衔接词是副词，不能像 so 那样把两句连在一个句子里。
for example / for instance 后面跟一个完整的句子：For example, running costs nothing.
such as 后面只能跟名词或名词短语（some sports, such as running），不能跟句子。
举例的写法是「先概括，再举例」：先给一个总体说法，再举一个具体的例子。
说明步骤按顺序用 first / then / finally，它们后面都加逗号。
for example 后面要加逗号，把它和后面的句子隔开。
although 是连词，后面跟一个完整的句子（有主语有谓语）。
despite / in spite of 是介词，后面只能跟名词或名词短语：despite the rain。
while 表示「而」，用来对比两个相反的事实；although 表示「虽然」，是让步。
让步从句放到主句前面时，从句后面要加逗号：Although it was raining, we went out.
even though 语气比 although 更强，但用法完全一样，后面也跟句子。
一般现在时讲习惯和事实：经常做的事、永远成立的事，都用它。
频度副词（always / usually / often / sometimes / never）要放在动词前面。
主语是第三人称单数（he / she / it / 一个人），动词要加 s。
否定看主语：I / you / we / they 用 don't，he / she / it 用 doesn't。
doesn't 出现后，动词回到原形（doesn't like，不是 doesn't likes）。
时刻表、班次这种按计划发生的事，也用一般现在时。
一般过去时讲过去发生的事：句子里的 last week / yesterday 就是提示。
规则动词加 ed：visit → visited，watch → watched。
不规则动词的过去式要单独记：go → went、buy → bought、see → saw，不会乖乖加 ed。
过去式不随人称变：She went，不是 She goes。
过去式和过去分词是两个东西：saw 是过去式，seen 是过去分词，不能单独当谓语。
Did 开头的疑问句里，动词要回到原形（Did you call，不是 Did you called）。
一般将来时：will + 动词原形，说的是将来会发生的事。
will 后面永远用原形：不加 s，也不加 ed。
will 的否定是在后面加 not（口语说 won't），动词还是原形。
tomorrow / soon / next week 这类时间词提示这是一般将来。
疑问句把 will 提到句首，动词保持原形。
现在进行时 = be + 动词 ing，两部分缺一不可。
be 动词跟着主语走：I 配 am，he / she / it 配 is，you / we / they 配 are。
be 后面必须跟 ing 形式，不能直接跟原形（is reading，不是 is read）。
以不发音的 e 结尾的动词，去掉 e 再加 ing：write → writing。
进行时的否定只在 be 后面加 not，动词还是 ing。
now / look / listen 这类词提示「此刻正在发生」。
过去进行时 = was / were + 动词 ing，表示过去某个时刻正在发生。
was 还是 were 只看主语：I / he / she / it 用 was，you / we / they 用 were。
主语只要不是单数，就用 were，跟句子讲的是谁没关系。
助动词后面必须跟 ing 形式（was reading，不是 was read）。
all morning / at that time 这类时间词提示「那段时间一直在做」。
疑问句：疑问词 + was / were + 主语 + doing。
现在完成时 = have / has + 过去分词，说的是「到现在为止的结果」。
主语是第三人称单数用 has，其它用 have。
have / has 后面必须跟过去分词，不能跟过去式（have seen，不是 have saw）。
for 加一段时间，表示从过去一直持续到现在。
have been to 表示「去过某地」，说的是人生经验。
just / already / ever 放在 have 和过去分词中间。
过去完成时 = had + 过去分词，表示「在过去某件事之前就已经完成」。
had 后面要用过去分词，不是过去式（had gone，不是 had went）。
already / just / never 放在 had 和过去分词中间。
had 不随人称变化：谁都用 had，没有 has / have 的写法。
句子里通常有一个过去的参照点（before dinner / by then）。
疑问句把 had 提到句首，动词保持过去分词。
将来完成时 = will have + 过去分词，表示「到将来某个时间点之前会完成」。
will 后面永远用原形 have，不能写成 has。
have 后面要用过去分词（will have finished，不是 will have finish）。
by + 时间点（by Friday / by then）是将来完成最常见的搭配。
不规则动词的过去分词要记牢：forget → forgotten，write → written。
疑问句把 will 提到句首，have + 过去分词跟着不变。
被动语态 = be + 过去分词：主语不是做事的，而是被做的那个。
be 动词跟着主语走：The letter was / These cars are，单复数要一致。
be 后面要用过去分词，不是过去式（was written，不是 was wrote）。
by 后面要用宾格：by her，不是 by she。
执行者不重要或不知道时，by 可以省略。
不规则动词的过去分词要记：write → written，speak → spoken，build → built，make → made。
先找时间词，再定时态：now 用现在进行，last Sunday 用一般过去。
tomorrow 用一般将来（will + 原形）；by then 用将来完成（will have + 过去分词）。
already / just / ever 配现在完成（have + 过去分词）；had + 过去分词是「过去的过去」。
主语是被做的那个，就用被动 be + 过去分词。
时态标志只出现一次：will 后面不再加 s，也不再加 ed。
频度副词放在动词前面；主语是三单，动词加 s。
不定式就是「to + 动词原形」—— to 后面永远不加 ing，也不加 s。
want / hope / plan / decide / need 后面接不定式，不接动名词。
不定式可以当宾语：I want to go 里，to go 就是 want 的宾语。
不定式也能当主语和表语：My dream is to travel the world；主语太长时用 it 占位。
主句动词随主语变（She wants），不定式里的动词永远保持原形（to be / to become）。
想说的是「去做某件事」时用 to + 原形，别把两个动词光秃秃地并排放。
动词加 ing 就不当动词了，变成名词，能当主语：Swimming is good for you（主语算单数，用 is）。
enjoy / finish / mind / keep 后面只能跟动名词：enjoy reading，不能说 enjoy read。
一个句子只能有一个谓语动词，第二个动词要变成动名词。
介词（for / of / at / in / about / without）后面跟动名词：for helping，不是 for help。
动名词也能作表语：My job is teaching English。
现在分词（-ing）放在名词前面，就等于一个形容词：sleeping baby = 正在睡觉的婴儿。
名词前面修饰它的动词要用分词，不能用原形：The sleeping baby，不是 The sleep baby。
see / watch / hear + 宾语 + 现在分词，表示「看见某人正在做某事」。
现在分词短语放在名词后面，等于省略了 who is 的定语从句。
从句尾的分词表示伴随的动作：She sat there reading a book。
一个句子只能有一个谓语动词，其余动词都要变成分词。
过去分词（-ed 或不规则形式）放在名词前面，表示「被……的」：broken window。
现在分词表示主动或正在进行，过去分词表示被动或已经完成。
be 动词后面要用过去分词，不是过去式：is written，不是 is wrote。
过去分词短语放在名词后面，等于被动语态的定语从句（which was written by him）。
see + 宾语 + 过去分词，表示「看见某物被……」。
不规则动词的过去式和过去分词要分清：write → wrote（过去式）→ written（过去分词）。
虚拟语气里 be 动词一律用 were，不管主语是谁：If I were you，不能用 was。
与现在事实相反：从句动词退一步用过去式（had / knew），主句用 would + 原形。
wish 后面的从句也用虚拟：I wish I knew，不是 I wish I know。
与过去事实相反：从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词。
虚拟语气说的是「事实不是这样」，所以动词要比事实往过去退一步。
否定词（never / seldom / hardly / little）放句首时，助动词要跑到主语前面：Never have I seen…（不是 Never I have seen）。
倒装后助动词承担时态，主动词一律回原形：Little did he know，不是 did he knew。
here / there 放在句首也要倒装：Here comes the bus。
only + 状语放在句首，主句同样要倒装：Only then did I understand。
先看句首那个词是不是否定词或 only 短语 —— 是，才需要倒装。
强调句的公式：It is/was + 被强调的部分 + that/who + 其余部分。
连接词永远是 that（强调人时也可以用 who），绝不能用 what。
强调时间、地点也用 that，不用 when / where。
It 后面用 is 还是 was，跟着原来那句话的时态走。
把 It is/was 和 that 去掉，剩下的话依然完整 —— 那才是强调句。

groups.label: 宾语 / 被强调的部分

rules: 不定式是 to + 动词原形：主句动词随主语变形，不定式里的动词不动。
动名词能当主语、宾语、表语；enjoy / finish 后面只跟动名词。
分词当形容词：现在分词表主动或进行，过去分词表被动或完成。
虚拟语气：be 动词一律用 were，从句退一步用过去式，主句用 would（+ have done）。
否定词提前要倒装：助动词跑到主语前面，主动词回原形。
强调句是 It is/was + 被强调的部分 + that/who，连接词不用 what / where / when。
第一次提到某个不确定的东西用 a；第二次提到同一个东西，读者已经知道是哪个了，要用 the。
指代前面一整件事（一整句话）只能用 this，不能用 these。
指代两个以上的人或物要用 them / they，不能用 it。
both of / some of 后面跟 them 指代复数名词，单复数要和前面一致。
回指之前先想一想：前面说的到底是一个，还是好几个？
段落开头的第一点用 first of all，后面加逗号。
补充第二点用 moreover / in addition / for another，不能用总结词。
段落最后收尾用 in conclusion / to sum up，后面加逗号。
for one thing ... for another 是固定搭配，专门用来说两个理由。
先看这句在段落里的位置：开头、中间、还是结尾，再挑衔接词。
句首的衔接词 / 状语后面要加逗号：In my opinion, online learning saves time.
in my opinion 放在开头表明看法；in conclusion 只能放在结尾做总结。
however 放句首时，前面是句号，后面是逗号 —— 前后都要有标点把它隔开。
First, / Second, / Third, 这些列举词后面也都跟逗号。
先看这句在段落里的位置（开头 / 中间 / 结尾），再挑衔接词。
转折用 however，因果用 as a result / therefore / consequently，别搞反。
第一次提到用 a，第二次提到同一个东西用 the。
后面跟句子用 for example / although；后面跟名词才用 such as / despite。
段落收尾用 to sum up / in conclusion。
挑衔接词之前，先想清楚两句是什么关系。
叙事段落按时间先后排：先找 at seven / After / Then / Finally 这类时间词，它们就是路标。
放在最后的那一句不能和前面矛盾 —— 比如早上出门的段落里不该出现晚上睡觉。

s: I woke up late this morning.
I skipped breakfast and ran out of the door.
On the way, I missed the bus.
I arrived at school ten minutes late.
d: I usually go to bed at ten.

s: Last summer, my family visited the seaside.
We set off before sunrise.
When we got there, the beach was almost empty.
We stayed until the sun went down.
d: My sister does not like the sea at all.

s: After dinner, I started my homework.
First I finished my maths exercises.
Then I reviewed my English notes.
I went to bed at eleven.
d: My desk is next to the window.

s: The party began at six in the evening.
Our friends arrived one after another.
We ate cake and played games.
Everyone left at ten o'clock.
d: The cake was made by my mother.

s: The exam started at nine.
I read every question carefully.
I finished the paper half an hour early.
I checked my answers twice before handing it in.
d: The classroom was very quiet.

s: My father taught me to ride a bike.
At first I fell off again and again.
After a week, I could ride a short distance.
Now I ride to school every day.
d: Bikes are cheaper than cars.

s: On Saturday morning, we cleaned the house.
In the afternoon, we went shopping.
In the evening, we watched a film together.
We went to bed early that night.
d: Sunday is my favourite day.

s: We moved to a new flat last month.
First we packed all our books.
Then the workers carried the boxes downstairs.
By the evening, everything was in the new place.
d: The new flat is on the fifth floor.

rules: 英语段落最常见的骨架：主题句（观点）→ 理由 → 例子 → 结论。
For example 一定跟在理由后面，In conclusion / To sum up 一定是最后一句。
表达同一个意思的第二点用 Moreover / It also，不要重复 First。

s: Online learning has become very popular.
It is convenient because you can study anywhere.
For example, you can watch a lesson on the bus.
In conclusion, online learning saves a lot of time.
d: My brother is a teacher in a middle school.

s: Reading is one of the best habits.
First of all, it builds your vocabulary.
Moreover, it helps you think more clearly.
To sum up, everyone should read every day.
d: Some books are very expensive.

s: Exercising every day is important.
It keeps your body strong.
It also makes you feel happier.
Therefore, we should exercise regularly.
d: I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday.

s: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
It gives you energy for the whole morning.
For example, students who eat breakfast concentrate better.
In short, we should never skip it.
d: Lunch is usually at twelve.

s: Learning a foreign language is good for you.
First, it opens the door to other cultures.
Moreover, it makes your brain work better.
In conclusion, everyone should learn at least one.
d: My cousin speaks three languages.

s: Saving money is a good habit.
It prepares you for unexpected problems.
It also helps you reach your long-term goals.
Therefore, we should save a little every month.
d: Bank cards are easy to use.

s: Enough sleep matters more than people think.
It helps your body recover from the day.
For example, students who sleep well get better grades.
To sum up, we should go to bed earlier.
d: My alarm clock is broken.

s: Good friends make life better.
They support you when things go wrong.
They also make happy moments more enjoyable.
In conclusion, we should value our friends.
d: I met my best friend at primary school.

rules: As a result 前面一定是原因，后面才是结果。
因果可以层层推进：修地铁 → 少开车 → 空气变好 → 得奖。
也可以先抛结果再倒回去讲原因，读起来更抓人。

s: The weather was terrible last weekend.
As a result, all the flights were canceled.
We had to stay at the airport for a whole night.
In the end, we took a train home.
d: The airport was very clean and modern.

s: Tom did not study for the exam.
Therefore, he failed it.
His parents were very disappointed.
He promised to work harder next time.
d: The exam was held in a large hall.

s: The city built a new subway line.
Therefore, many people gave up driving.
As a result, the air became much cleaner.
Finally, the city won an environmental prize.
d: The new line has twenty stations.

s: The small shop closed last month.
The rent had gone up twice in one year.
As a result, the owner could not make any profit.
Finally, he decided to move to another street.
d: The shop used to sell fresh vegetables.

s: I stayed up late playing games.
So I overslept the next morning.
As a result, I missed the first class.
I decided never to stay up so late again.
d: My phone is two years old.

s: It rained for a whole week.
The river rose above its banks.
As a result, several villages were flooded.
The government sent food and water to the area.
d: Farming is important in that area.

s: I forgot to charge my phone.
Therefore, it died in the middle of the day.
As a result, I could not find the meeting room.
I was half an hour late.
d: The meeting room is on the third floor.

s: The bookstore began selling coffee.
More people came in every day.
Therefore, the owner opened a second shop.
Now the shop is famous in the city.
d: Books are usually cheaper online.

rules: First / Then / Next / Finally 本身就是顺序，照着排就行。
步骤之间有先后依赖（没借书证就没法借书），顺序不能换。
和步骤无关的背景介绍不要放进来，会把动作顺序打断。

s: First, boil some water.
Then, put a tea bag into the cup.
Next, pour the hot water into the cup.
Finally, wait for three minutes and enjoy it.
d: Tea is very popular in many countries.

s: First, you need a library card.
Then, you can search for books on the computer.
After that, write down the book number.
Finally, ask the librarian if you cannot find it.
d: The library closes at nine on weekdays.

s: First, write a clear subject line.
Then, greet the person politely.
After that, state your purpose in one or two sentences.
Finally, end with a polite closing.
d: Many people check their email every hour.

s: First, wash and cut the vegetables.
Then, heat some oil in the pan.
Next, put the rice and vegetables in and stir.
Finally, add a little salt and serve it hot.
d: Rice is the main food in many Asian countries.

s: First, fill in the application form.
Then, take a photo that meets the rules.
After that, hand in your documents at the office.
Finally, collect your passport two weeks later.
d: Passports are checked at the airport.

s: First, decide what your main idea is.
Then, write down two or three reasons.
After that, add an example for each reason.
Finally, write a short conclusion.
d: Writing takes a lot of practice.

s: First, put the clothes into the machine.
Then, add the washing powder.
Next, choose the right program.
Finally, press the start button.
d: Washing machines are quite cheap now.

s: First, check whether the person is breathing.
Then, call for an ambulance.
After that, keep the person warm.
Finally, stay with them until help arrives.
d: First aid saves thousands of lives every year.

rules: On the one hand 和 On the other hand 是成套的：一段讲好处，一段讲坏处，顺序固定。
结论句不能偏袒一边 —— 用 it depends / the best choice 这类折中的说法。
对比两边要讲同一类事情才公平：都是使用感受，或者都是成本。

s: Living in a city has both advantages and disadvantages.
On the one hand, it offers more job opportunities.
On the other hand, the cost of living is much higher.
In conclusion, it depends on what you value most.
d: My uncle has lived in the same city for thirty years.

s: Some people prefer to work from home.
They say it saves both time and money.
However, others find it hard to stay focused at home.
Therefore, the best choice depends on the person.
d: The company moved to a new office last year.

s: Both paper books and e-books have their fans.
Paper books are easier on the eyes.
E-books, on the other hand, are much lighter to carry.
In the end, it is a matter of personal taste.
d: I read three books last month.

s: Online shopping has changed the way we buy things.
On the one hand, it is fast and convenient.
On the other hand, you cannot touch the goods before paying.
In short, we should weigh the pros and cons.
d: Delivery usually takes two or three days.

s: Where to live is a hard question for young people.
Big cities offer better schools and hospitals.
Small towns, however, are quieter and much cheaper.
It depends on what you need at this stage of life.
d: Rents in big cities keep going up.

s: Both classroom lessons and online courses have strengths.
Classroom lessons give you a teacher right in front of you.
Online courses, on the other hand, let you study at your own pace.
The best plan is probably to combine them.
d: Our school has thirty classrooms.

s: Smartphones are part of everyday life now.
On the one hand, they keep us connected all the time.
On the other hand, they take away our attention.
The key is to use them wisely.
d: My phone has a very good camera.

s: People argue about whether to get up early.
Early risers say the morning is the most productive time.
Night owls, however, work better when the world is quiet.
In the end, what matters is a regular schedule.
d: I set three alarms every night.

rules: 先判断这一段属于哪种骨架：时间线、总分总、因果、对比还是流程。
找到最硬的信号词（As a result / In conclusion / First / On the other hand），它们的位置基本就定死了。
叙述类段落里，那句和整段时间线或逻辑冲突的，就是多余的。

s: Last Friday, our class went on a school trip.
We set off at six in the morning.
After two hours, we reached the mountain.
We climbed to the top and took many photos.
In the evening, we came back home, tired but happy.
d: Our teacher is very strict with us.

s: Learning a foreign language is good for you.
First, it opens the door to other cultures.
Moreover, it makes your brain work better.
For example, studies show it can improve memory.
In conclusion, everyone should learn at least one foreign language.
d: My cousin speaks three languages.

s: The small shop closed last month.
The rent had gone up twice in one year.
As a result, the owner could not make any profit.
Finally, he decided to move to another street.
d: The shop used to sell fresh vegetables.

s: Online shopping has changed the way we buy things.
On the one hand, it is fast and convenient.
On the other hand, you cannot touch the goods before paying.
In short, we should weigh the pros and cons.
d: Delivery usually takes two or three days.

s: First, decide what your main idea is.
Then, write down two or three reasons.
After that, add an example for each reason.
Finally, write a short conclusion.
d: Writing takes a lot of practice.

s: It rained for a whole week.
The river rose above its banks.
As a result, several villages were flooded.
The government sent food and water to the area.
d: Farming is important in that area.

rules: 宾语从句里用正常语序：where he lives。主语排在动词前面 —— 写成 where lives he 就成疑问句的语序了。
从句有自己的主语，动词就跟着它变：he lives、they live、I am。语序摆平以后，三单的 s 不能丢。
说一件确定的事用 that；说「是否、会不会」用 if。that 和 if / what 别混着用。
主句和从句各管各的主谓：主句主语是三单，主句动词照样要加 s（She says…）。
从句整体当主语时，从句里用正常语序：What he said is true。动词排在主语后面，别写成 What said he。
从句有自己的主谓：he knows / they know / we study。动词跟着从句的主语变。
主语从句太长，就用 it 先占住句首：It is important that…。写成 That is important that… 就错了。
主语从句当一件事看，主句动词用单数：What he said is true，不是 are。
从句说的是确定的事就用 that 引导，别拿 what 或 if 去顶 that。
The reason is that…：be 动词后面用 that 引导，不用 because。用了 because 就等于把「因为」说了两遍。
be 动词后面说「是否」只能用 whether，不能用 if。
be 动词后面说「……的东西」用 what：That is what I want。
从句照样有自己的主谓，动词跟着从句的主语变：he was / we are / he knows。
That is why… 表示「这就是……的原因」，后面照样是「主语 + 动词」，不倒装。

groups.label: 定语从句（修饰主语 NP）
定语从句（修饰宾语 NP）

rules: 先行词是人，定语从句用 who：the man who called。用 which 指人是最常见的错。
先行词是物，从句用 which（或用 that）：the book which I bought。物不能用 who。
what 不能引导定语从句 —— 关系代词前面得先有一个名词。
从句动词跟先行词一致：the boys who speak / the man who speaks。

groups.label: 定语从句（修饰主语 NP）
定语从句（修饰宾语 NP）

rules: whose 表示「谁的」，后面必须紧跟一个名词：the boy whose father…。用 who 就成了 who father。
别用 his / her 代替 whose：I know the boy whose father is a doctor。
that 人和物都能指；指物不能用 who，指人常用 who 或 that。
从句和主句的动词各跟着自己的主语：the boys who speak、the book that was good。
先行词是 the reason 时，从句用 why：the reason why I left。
主句和从句的时态要一致：主句是过去式，从句也用过去式。I was reading when he called。
主句进行时是 was / were + doing：I was reading，不是 I was read。
别让一句话里一个过去、一个现在：We waited until the rain stopped。
because 和 so 只能留一个。中文说「因为……所以……」，英语里用了 because 就不能再要 so。
主句和从句的时态要配套：主句过去，从句也过去（stayed…rained）。
didn't 后面用动词原形：didn't come，不是 didn't came。
主将从现：主句用 will，从句用一般现在时。从句里别用过去式，也不出现 will。
从句照样跟自己的主语一致：it rains、he has、you don't hurry。
will 后面永远跟动词原形：will stay / will come，不加 s 也不变过去式。
unless 本身就带「除非、如果不」的意思，后面再加 don't / won't 就重复否定了。
宾语从句里用正常语序；说「是否」用 if，陈述一件事实用 that。
从句里动词跟着从句自己的主语变，别把助动词搬进去倒装。
主语从句太长就用 it 占位（It is important that…）；主语从句当单数看，主句动词用 is。
表语从句用 that 或 whether：The reason is that…，不是 because；be 动词后面不用 if。
定语从句看先行词：人用 who，物用 which，都可以用 that；whose 后面必须跟名词。
状语从句的时态跟主句配套：主将从现、主过从过；because 和 so 只留一个。
